description: This file defines the EntityDatatableCheckNotSupportedException class, a custom runtime exception used within the Fineract project to indicate unsupported datatable check operations on entities.

classes.name: EntityDatatableCheckNotSupportedException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException, thrown when datatable resource checks are not supported for specific entities in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: EntityDatatableCheckNotSupportedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating that the datatable check is not supported for a given table and entity.

methods.name: EntityDatatableCheckNotSupportedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating that the datatable check is not supported for a specific entity with a product ID.
